title: 实验 3-1 · RC 充放电：用方波看时间常数
summary: 信号发生器输出 0–5 V 方波，经 10 kΩ 给 100 nF 电容充放电；改变频率，看电容电压在半个周期里能走多远。
concepts: 零状态响应 / 零输入响应
description: **目标**：用方波反复给 RC 电路充放电，在示波器上看一阶电路的指数曲线，并看清时间常数 τ 和信号周期的比值怎样决定波形。
**电路**：信号发生器红夹子 → R1（10 kΩ）→ 结点 VC → C1（100 nF）→ GND；信号发生器黑夹子接 GND。
**信号发生器设置**：方波（square），幅度 2.5 V、偏置 2.5 V，也就是在 0 V 和 5 V 之间跳变。方波的高电平半周期相当于“开关合上给电容充电”，低电平半周期相当于“开关拨到地让电容放电”——一个方波就是一台每秒自动开关几百次的直流电路。
**示波器**：CH1 接信号发生器输出（R1 左端），CH2 接 VC（电容上端），两个探头的地夹都接 GND。
**先预测**：用三要素法写出充电和放电半周期的 u_C(t)，算出 τ = RC（R 要算上信号发生器的 50 Ω 输出电阻）。再估计 50 Hz、500 Hz、5 kHz 三个频率下，半个周期是几个 τ，CH2 的最大值、最小值和形状各是什么样。经验规律：过了 1τ 走完 63%，3τ 走完 95%，5τ 走完 99.3%。
**测量**：依次把频率设成 50 Hz、500 Hz、5 kHz，读 CH2 的最大值、最小值和 Vpp，看波形形状。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**想一想**：如果只看 500 Hz 的 Vpp，你能反过来算出 τ 吗？
startNote: **半成品**：信号发生器（已经设好波形）和两个示波器探头已经接好。**为什么**：仪器的接法第 12、13 课练过，这个实验要看的是电路本身的波形。**你要做**：加上 R1（10kΩ，第 3 列 → 第 10 列）和 C1（100nF，第 10 列 → GND）。

en.title: Experiment 3-1 · RC charging: see the time constant with a square wave
en.summary: A 0–5 V square wave charges and discharges a 100 nF capacitor through 10 kΩ; change the frequency and see how far the capacitor voltage gets in half a period.
description: **Goal**: charge and discharge an RC circuit over and over with a square wave, watch the first-order exponentials on the scope, and see how the ratio of the time constant τ to the signal period shapes the waveform.
**Circuit**: generator red clip → R1 (10 kΩ) → node VC → C1 (100 nF) → GND; the generator's black clip goes to GND.

**Generator settings**: square wave, amplitude 2.5 V, offset 2.5 V — it jumps between 0 V and 5 V. The high half-period is like "switch closed, charge the capacitor", the low half-period like "switch to ground, discharge it": a square wave is a DC circuit with a switch flipped automatically hundreds of times a second.
**Scope**: CH1 on the generator output (left end of R1), CH2 on VC (top of the capacitor), both ground clips on GND.

**Predict first**: write u_C(t) for the charging and discharging half-periods with the three-element method and work out τ = RC (R must include the generator's 50 Ω output resistance). Then estimate, for 50 Hz, 500 Hz and 5 kHz, how many τ fit in half a period and what CH2's maximum, minimum and shape will be. Rules of thumb: after 1τ the voltage has covered 63% of the way, after 3τ 95%, after 5τ 99.3%.

**Measure**: set the frequency to 50 Hz, 500 Hz and 5 kHz in turn; read CH2's maximum, minimum and Vpp and look at the shape. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.
**Think about it**: if you only knew the Vpp at 500 Hz, could you work back to τ?
en.startNote: **Half-built**: The function generator (already set up) and both scope probes are wired. **Why**: lessons 12 and 13 covered connecting the instruments; this lab is about the circuit's own waveforms. **Your job**: add R1 (10kΩ, column 3 → column 10) and C1 (100nF, column 10 → GND).
compare: **Compare**: charging, u(∞) = 5 V and u_C(t) = 5 − [5 − u(0+)]·e^(−t/τ); discharging, u(∞) = 0 and u_C(t) = u(0+)·e^(−t/τ). τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ 1.0 ms.

- **50 Hz**: half a period is 10 ms ≈ 10τ. The capacitor fills up to almost 5 V and empties to almost 0 V every time; CH2 shows the textbook "exponential rise + exponential fall", max ≈ 5.0 V, min ≈ 0.0 V.

- **500 Hz**: half a period is 1 ms ≈ τ. The capacitor starts discharging before it is full and settles into a swing between two levels: Vpp = 5 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 5 × tanh(0.5) ≈ 2.3 V, about 1.35 V to 3.65 V, centred on 2.5 V.

- **5 kHz**: half a period is 0.1 ms = 0.1τ. Each half-period covers only the very first, almost straight, bit of the exponential, so CH2 becomes a **triangle wave** of about 0.25 Vpp sitting on 2.5 V (the square wave's average).

Where the Vpp formula comes from: in steady state the capacitor swings between VL and VH. Charging: VH = 5 − (5 − VL)·e^(−T/2τ); discharging: VL = VH·e^(−T/2τ). Solving both gives VH − VL = 5·(1 − e^(−T/2τ))/(1 + e^(−T/2τ)) = 5·tanh(T/4τ).

measurements.ask: 50 Hz: the time t_r CH2's rising edge takes from 10% to 90% (0.5 V → 4.5 V), read off the scope's time grid
From your t_r, the time constant τ = t_r / ln 9
measurements.explain: An exponential takes exactly τ·ln 9 ≈ 2.2τ from 10% to 90%. τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ 1.0 ms.
Half a period ≈ τ, so the capacitor never fills: Vpp = 5 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 2.3 V.

hints: The generator's black clip goes to GND; the capacitor goes from VC to GND.
Square wave 0–5 V means amplitude 2.5 V (peak) plus offset 2.5 V.
τ = (R + 50 Ω)·C. Compare half a period T/2 = 1/(2f) with τ to predict the shape.
tests: 50 Hz (T/2 ≫ τ): the capacitor fills and empties every time
500 Hz (T/2 ≈ τ): it never fills, swinging about the centre
5 kHz (T/2 ≪ τ): only a small triangle is left

tests.name: 50 Hz（T/2 ≫ τ）：电容每次都充满、放空
500 Hz（T/2 ≈ τ）：来不及充满，围绕中心来回
5 kHz（T/2 ≪ τ）：只剩一个小三角波

compare: - **50 Hz**：半个周期 10 ms ≈ 10τ。电容每次都几乎充满到 5 V、放空到 0 V，CH2 是标准的“指数上升 + 指数下降”，最大约 5.0 V、最小约 0.0 V。
- **500 Hz**：半个周期 1 ms ≈ τ。电容来不及充满就开始放电，稳定后在两个值之间来回：Vpp = 5 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 5 × tanh(0.5) ≈ 2.3 V，大约 1.35 V ~ 3.65 V，中心 2.5 V。
- **5 kHz**：半个周期 0.1 ms = 0.1τ。每半周期只走了指数曲线最开头几乎是直线的一小段，CH2 变成一个约 0.25 Vpp 的**三角波**，骑在 2.5 V（方波的平均值）上。
Vpp 公式的来历：稳态时电容在 VL 和 VH 之间来回，充电半周期 VH = 5 − (5 − VL)·e^(−T/2τ)，放电半周期 VL = VH·e^(−T/2τ)，两式联立就得到 VH − VL = 5·(1 − e^(−T/2τ))/(1 + e^(−T/2τ)) = 5·tanh(T/4τ)。

measurements.ask: 50 Hz：CH2 的上升沿从 10% 升到 90%（0.5 V → 4.5 V）用的时间 t_r（从示波器的时间格读）
由你读的 t_r 算时间常数 τ = t_r / ln 9
measurements.explain: 指数曲线从 10% 到 90% 正好要 τ·ln 9 ≈ 2.2τ。τ = (10 kΩ + 50 Ω) × 100 nF ≈ 1.0 ms。
半个周期 ≈ τ，电容来不及充满：Vpp = 5 V × tanh(T/(4τ)) ≈ 2.3 V。

hints: 信号发生器的黑夹子接 GND；电容从 VC 接到 GND。
0–5 V 方波 = 幅度（峰值）2.5 V + 偏置 2.5 V。
τ = (R + 50 Ω)·C。拿半个周期 T/2 = 1/(2f) 和 τ 比一比，就能猜出波形的样子。
